plan.notes: Official East Carolina University 2026-2027 Engineering BS requirements (ECU Degree Explorer; program is ABET-accredited). The catalog publishes official degree requirements with no official semester sequence; collected as a single requirements block. ECU publishes block-level semester-hour totals but NOT per-course credit values; recorded as official block totals at catalog minimums (Gen Ed 40, Foundation 44, Cognates 19 of 19-21, one 22 s.h. concentration = 125 s.h. minimum program total). Per-course credits are NOT published and were not invented.

courses.title: General Education (40 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 40 s.h. general education block; per-course credits not published. Includes: BIOL 1050 + BIOL 1051 OR BIOL 1100 + BIOL 1101; CHEM 1150 General Chemistry I; additional gen ed courses (check with advisor: some math/science courses cannot count due to accreditation restrictions).

courses.title: Engineering foundation (44 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 44 s.h. engineering foundation block; per-course credits not published. Courses: ENGR 1000, 1012, 1016, 2000, 2001, 2022, 2050, 2070, 2450, 2514, 3000, 3024, 3034, 3050, 3420, 3800, 4010, 4020 (titles per official program page).

courses.title: Cognates (19 s.h., catalog range 19-21)
courses.choice_note: Cognates block: catalog range 19-21 s.h., recorded at minimum 19. Per-course credits not published. Courses: CHEM 1151; MATH 2152 or 2172; MATH 2153 or 2173; MATH 2171 (3 s.h. counts toward gen ed math); MATH 3307; MATH 3331; PHYS 2350 (counts as gen ed elective); PHYS 2360.

courses.title: Engineering concentration (22 s.h., choose one of six)
courses.choice_note: Choose one 22 s.h. concentration: Biochemical (BCHE 3013, 3250, 4006, 4010, 4020, CHEM 1160/1161, 6 s.h. technical electives); Biomedical (BIME 2080, 3043, 4030, 4050, 4200, 6 s.h. technical electives); Electrical (EENG 2410, 3013, 3023, 3040, 3750, 4510, 3 s.h. technical electives); Environmental (CHEM 1160/1161, ENVE 3103, 3203, 3303, 4103, 4203, 3 s.h. technical electives); Industrial and Systems (ISE 3010, 3060, 4010, 4020, 4065, 7 s.h. technical electives); Mechanical (MENG 3073, 3624, 4153, 4263, 4650, 7 s.h. technical electives). Per-course credits not published.
